extension.description: Edit Excel and CSV files directly in VS Code, with formulas, table filters, formatting, charts and AI agent tools.
configuration.headlessWrites: Allow AI agent tools to modify spreadsheet files that are not open in an editor. Changes are saved to disk. Requires a trusted workspace.
workspaceTrust.description: The spreadsheet editor is available in Restricted Mode. AI agent tools can modify unopened files only in trusted workspaces.
configuration.checkForUpdates: Check GitHub Releases for a newer version of Sheets when VS Code starts.
walkthrough.title: Get started with Sheets
walkthrough.description: Open a spreadsheet, try a formula, find values and save your work.
walkthrough.open.title: Open or create a workbook
walkthrough.open.description:
XLSX and XLSM files open in Sheets by default. For CSV/TSV, use **Open with Sheets** in the Explorer context menu.
[Open a spreadsheet](command:sheets.openFile)
[Create an XLSX workbook](command:sheets.newWorkbook)
walkthrough.edit.title: Enter values and formulas
walkthrough.edit.description: Select A1, type `10` and press Enter. Enter `20` in A2, then `=SUM(A1:A2)` in A3: the result is **30**. Use English function names and commas, also in the German UI. Double-click a cell to edit it; use the toolbar to format the selection. Continue by selecting the next step.
walkthrough.find.title: Find your data
walkthrough.find.description:
Keep a spreadsheet open and use the button below to open Find. Search values or formulas, choose the sheet or workbook scope, and press Escape to return to the grid.
[Open Find](command:sheets.find)
walkthrough.save.title: Save or export
walkthrough.save.description: Return to your spreadsheet and press **Ctrl+S** (macOS: **Cmd+S**) to save. For a separate CSV/TSV copy, run **Sheets: Export Sheet as CSV…** in the Command Palette. CSV stores only values from one sheet. If an XLSX protection message appears, undo the unsupported change before saving. Continue by selecting the next step.
walkthrough.manual.title: Explore the user manual
walkthrough.manual.description:
Find step-by-step instructions for tables, filters, charts, validation, AI tools and troubleshooting. The manual opens in your VS Code language, with a link to the other language.
[Open user manual](command:sheets.openManual)
